_registration.purpose: Lebanese entry visas for artists engaged by touristic enterprises: the documents and monthly fees by venue class, the Unified Mutual Fund contract endorsement and 10% levy required before any other step, and the six-month residency available to artists who do not work in nightclubs.

source_titles.requirements_526: Amendment of Required Documents for Obtaining an Artist Visa
source_titles.requirements_48: Entry visa of an artist to touristic enterprises

policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the Lebanese General Directorate of General Security page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. Every excerpt was taken by line offset out of a NUMBERED dump of text this project’s own fetcher retrieved and this project’s own normaliser processed, then re-verified against a fresh fetch.
structure_note:
Three pages, and the ORDER between them is the requirement. `posts/526` is an instruction issued under the 2008 law on artistic professions: the contract must be endorsed by the Unified Mutual Fund and the 10% fee paid to the Ministry of Finance BEFORE any other procedure, on pain of rejection and legal action. `posts/48` is the visa document list and the monthly fees, which differ by venue class — LBP 15,000,000 for a class B venue and LBP 30,000,000 for class A. `posts/413` is the separate six-month residency, available only to artists who do NOT work in nightclubs.

The fees are per artist per month, not per application, and both are quoted with the venue class that earns them.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateline and no Last-Modified header, and its body references 2026. Freshness therefore rests on a body-year rather than a publication date — the same state check-source-freshness already reports for Singapore's MOM pages, the US ESTA pages and all of Austria's migration.gv.at. The daily sync is what will notice if the text moves.
not_extracted: Residence Permits for Iraqi Nationals in Lebanon (posts/428). The served page carries five lines that refer to "the residency mentioned in item (2) above" and "residency applications mentioned in item (1) above" — and items (1) and (2) are NOT on the page in any form, in the normalised text or in the raw HTML. Publishing a cross-reference to a list the reader cannot see would be worse than publishing nothing.
The Arabic-language tree. This authority publishes English and Arabic separately; only the English tree is read, and no claim is made that the two say the same thing.

Routes still enumerated on the index and not yet extracted: sponsorship transfer applications, the complaint procedure for an escaping foreign worker, temporary residence renewal via LibanPost, applying for a visa renewal via Liban Post, the kafala-transfer regularisation, entry of nationals from labour-supplying countries, work permits for foreign artists and musicians, entry of artists in nightclubs, and the Syrian and Palestinian arrangements. Named so the gap is a known quantity rather than an impression of completeness.

requirements.label: Non-compliance means rejection and legal action
requirements.description: Addressed to all individuals or companies recruiting Arab and foreign artists.
requirements.source_excerpt: all individuals or companies recruiting arab and foreign artists are required to strictly comply with the following procedures, under penalty of having their applications rejected and facing legal action:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: all individuals or companies recruiting Arab and foreign artists are required to strictly comply with the following procedures, under penalty of having their applications rejected and facing legal action:

requirements.label: FIRST: the contract must be endorsed by the Unified Mutual Fund before any other step
requirements.description: The original signed contract must carry the Fund's official stamp before anything else proceeds.
requirements.source_excerpt: the original contract signed with the foreign artist must be presented in advance to the unified mutual fund for artists, and the official endorsement stamp of the fund must be obtained on the contract before proceeding with any other procedures.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The original contract signed with the foreign artist must be presented in advance to the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists, and the official endorsement stamp of the Fund must be obtained on the contract before proceeding with any other procedures.

requirements.label: SECOND: 10% of the contract value paid to the Ministry of Finance
requirements.description: In favour of the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists, with an official receipt.
requirements.source_excerpt: a fee of 10% of the contract value must be paid to the ministry of finance in favor of the unified mutual fund for artists, and an official receipt proving payment must be obtained according to the proper procedures.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A fee of 10% of the contract value must be paid to the Ministry of Finance in favor of the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists, and an official receipt proving payment must be obtained according to the proper procedures.

requirements.label: THIRD: what the entry-visa application must include
requirements.description: The two items below are the authority's own list.
requirements.source_excerpt: applications for entry visas submitted to the competent general security departments must include:
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Applications for entry visas submitted to the competent General Security departments must include:

requirements.description: The output of step one becomes an input to the visa.
requirements.source_excerpt: • a copy of the original contract stamped by the unified mutual fund for artists.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: • A copy of the original contract stamped by the Unified Mutual Fund for Artists.

requirements.label: A copy of the Ministry of Finance receipt for the 10% fee
requirements.description: The output of step two becomes an input to the visa.
requirements.source_excerpt: • a copy of the receipt of payment of the 10% fee issued by the ministry of finance.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: • A copy of the receipt of payment of the 10% fee issued by the Ministry of Finance.

requirements.label: A filled-out application
requirements.description: First of the artist-visa document list.
requirements.source_excerpt: a filled out application.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A filled out application.

requirements.label: An engagement of guarantee
requirements.description: From the artist-visa document list.
requirements.source_excerpt: an engagement of guarantee.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: An engagement of guarantee.

requirements.description: Signed and dated by both parties; the three stated terms are what make it acceptable.
requirements.source_excerpt: a work contract dated and signed by the 2 interested parties, in which the date and the duration of the shows are mentioned as well as the remuneration granted to the artist.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A work contract dated and signed by the 2 interested parties, in which the date and the duration of the shows are mentioned as well as the remuneration granted to the artist.

requirements.label: An agreement between the convener and the owner of the venue
requirements.description: From the artist-visa document list.
requirements.source_excerpt: an agreement between convener and the owner of the location where the show is held.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: An agreement between convener and the owner of the location where the show is held.

requirements.source_excerpt: a financial guarantee for each artist.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A financial guarantee for each artist.

requirements.label: An investment permit and the enterprise’s financial and commercial register

requirements.source_excerpt_display: An investment permit, a financial and commercial register of the concerned enterprise.

requirements.source_excerpt_display: A certified copy of the ID card held by convener (as well as a copy of the ID card held by the representative and the proxy used).

requirements.source_excerpt_display: A certified copy of the passport held by the artist in 3 clear copies.

requirements.source_excerpt: 2 photos 4x4.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 2 photos 4x4.

requirements.source_excerpt: 4 fiscal stamps of 20,000 l.l.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 4 fiscal stamps of 20,000 L.L.

requirements.label: A receipt for the 10% artists’ mutual fund fee, with the exceptions named
requirements.description: Modelling, massage and nightclub workers are excepted, and the exception travels with the requirement.
requirements.source_excerpt: a receipt showing that a 10% fee has been paid to the artists’ mutual fund, as well as a certified copy of the work contract approved by the ministry of finance (except for the workers employed in modeling, massaging, and nightclubs).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A receipt showing that a 10% fee has been paid to the Artists’ Mutual Fund, as well as a certified copy of the work contract approved by the ministry of finance (except for the workers employed in modeling, massaging, and nightclubs).

requirements.label: LBP 15,000,000 per month per artist — class B venue (1 or 2 stars)
requirements.description: Per artist per month, and the venue class is what sets it.
requirements.source_excerpt: 15.000.000 l.b.p – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class b (1 or 2 stars).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 15.000.000 L.B.P – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class B (1 or 2 stars).

requirements.label: LBP 30,000,000 per month per artist — class A venue (3 stars or more)
requirements.description: Double the class B fee, quoted separately so the two cannot merge.
requirements.source_excerpt: 30.000.000 l.b.p – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class a (3 stars or more).
requirements.source_excerpt_display: 30.000.000 L.B.P – every month for each artist if the location of the show is class A (3 stars or more).

requirements.source_excerpt_display: NB: Before the departure of the artist, a financial register has to be delivered to the general security.

requirements.source_excerpt_display: First: Foreign artists, who do not work in Nightclubs, can obtain temporary residency for a period of six months at once, on the condition that:

requirements.source_excerpt: • possession of a valid employment contract for the duration of residence.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: • Possession of a valid employment contract for the duration of residence.

requirements.source_excerpt_display: • Payment of the fees in accordance with the rules.
